title: National Stock Exchange of India IPO Details
intro:
NSE IPO is a book build issue of ₹22,561.57 crores. The issue is entirely an offer for sale of 12.64 crore shares of ₹22,561.57 crore.

NSE IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 17, 2026 and will close on Sep 21, 2026. The allotment for the NSE IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 22, 2026. NSE IPO will list on the BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 24, 2026.

NSE IPO is set issue price band at ₹1,700 to ₹1,785 per share. The lot size for an application is 8 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,280 (8 shares) (based on upper price).

The issue includes a reservation of up to 4,33,437 shares for employees offered at a discount of ₹170.00 to the issue price.

Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

NSE provides a vertically integrated ecosystem comprising trading, clearing, settlement, listing, market data, index services, and regulatory oversight across multiple asset classes, including equities, derivatives, currency derivatives, commodities, debt securities, and mutual funds. NSE has consistently maintained its leadership position in India in cash market turnover, equity derivatives trading, and currency derivatives trading. As of June 30, 2026, the exchange served over 261.36 million registered investor accounts, 129 million unique investors, 1,328 trading members, and 3,005 listed companies, with a total listed market capitalization of approximately ₹474.08 trillion. The exchange operates on a highly scalable and resilient technology infrastructure that supports high-frequency trading, real-time market data dissemination, risk management, surveillance, and regulatory compliance. Additionally, it also has non-trading revenue stream to cater to diverse needs, such as: NSE Clearing Ltd. offering clearing services. In Fiscal 2026, its market share is 88.42% in cash market, 91.04% in equity derivatives, and 74.09% in exchange-traded derivatives. NSE Indices Ltd. develops and manages a wide range of indices. NSE Data and Analytics Ltd. offering data analytics services, providing comprehensive real-time market data, benchmark data, fixed income valuations and analytical tools to institutional investors, asset managers and regulator. NSE International Exchange offering foreign currency denominated trading services. faqs.question: How to apply in NSE IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in NSE IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in NSE IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in NSE IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' NSE IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When NSE IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The NSE IPO opens on Thu, Sep 17, 2026 and closes on Mon, Sep 21, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of NSE IPO?
faqs.answer: NSE IPO lot size is 8 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,280 .

faqs.question: How to apply for NSE IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in NSE IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is NSE IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for NSE IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 22, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 23, 2026 . Check the NSE IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is NSE IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The NSE IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Sep 24, 2026 .
